name: Agentics Maintenance
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts'
      - 'build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts'
      - 'build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts'

jobs:
  check-duplication:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd build-tools
          npm ci
          
      - name: Check for duplicated code
        id: check_duplication
        run: |
          # Extract the duplicated code blocks from both files
          echo "Checking for duplicated code in latestVersions commands..."
          
          # Get the code block from legacy command (lines ~50-95)
          LEGACY_CODE=$(sed -n '50,95p' build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
          
          # Get the code block from vnext command (lines ~64-109)
          VNEXT_CODE=$(sed -n '64,109p' build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
          
          # Compare the code blocks
          if [ "$LEGACY_CODE" = "$VNEXT_CODE" ]; then
            echo "DUPLICATION_FOUND=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "Duplicated code detected between legacy and vnext commands"
          else
            echo "DUPLICATION_FOUND=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "No exact duplication found"
          fi
          
      - name: Report duplication status
        if: env.DUPLICATION_FOUND == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "❌ Duplication detected in latestVersions commands"
          echo "The 'latest stable version by major' decision logic is duplicated."
          echo "Files affected:"
          echo "- build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts"
          echo "- build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts"
          echo ""
          echo "Impact: This duplication increases maintenance burden and risk of inconsistent behavior."
          echo "Recommendation: Extract common logic into a shared utility function."
          
      - name: Create issue if duplication exists
        if: env.DUPLICATION_FOUND == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: issues } = await github.rest.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              labels: ['maintenance', 'duplication']
            });
            
            const existingIssue = issues.find(issue => 
              issue.title.includes('latestVersions duplication') ||
              issue.body?.includes('latestVersions') ||
              issue.body?.includes('duplicated code')
            );
            
            if (!existingIssue) {
              await github.rest.issues.create({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                title: 'Refactor: Remove duplicated latestVersions logic in build-cli',
                body: `## Duplication Detected\n\nThe 'latest stable version by major' decision logic is duplicated between:\n\n- \`build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts\`\n- \`build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts\`\n\nThis duplication (~40-50 lines) increases maintenance burden and risks inconsistent behavior.\n\n### Recommendation\nExtract the common logic into a shared utility function to eliminate duplication.`,
                labels: ['maintenance', 'refactor', 'duplication']
              });
            }
